evals.prompt: I have a .NET MAUI app using ZXing.Net.Maui for barcode scanning. I want to replace it with BarcodeCapture. Here is my page: ZxingMauiPage.xaml + ZxingMauiPage.xaml.cs
evals.expected_output: Removes the ZXing.Net.Maui XAML control, namespace, options, and event handler. Replaces with <scandit:DataCaptureView> + BarcodeCapture mode + HandlerChanged overlay creation. Maps the ZXing formats (Ean13, Code128, QrCode) to Scandit symbologies (Ean13Upca, Code128, Qr). Preserves the ScannedBarcode record and deduplication logic.

assertions.text: ZXing.Net.Maui using directives are NOT present in the new code
<zxing:CameraBarcodeReaderView is NOT present in the updated XAML (may appear in a before/after summary table)
The xmlns:zxing namespace is NOT present in the updated XAML
BarcodeReaderOptions is NOT present in the new code
Scandit.DataCapture using directives ARE present
<scandit:DataCaptureView> is present in the updated XAML
The xmlns:scandit="clr-namespace:Scandit.DataCapture.Core.UI.Maui;assembly=ScanditCaptureCoreMaui" namespace is added
The BarcodeScanned event is wired (barcodeCapture.BarcodeScanned += ...)
Symbology.Ean13Upca is enabled
Symbology.Code128 is enabled
Symbology.Qr is enabled (not Symbology.QrCode, which does not exist)
Symbology.QrCode does NOT appear as a Symbology enum value (BarcodeFormat.QrCode in a summary table is acceptable)
BarcodeCaptureOverlay.Create(barcodeCapture) is called inside dataCaptureView.HandlerChanged
dataCaptureView.AddOverlay(overlay) is called
OnAppearing turns the camera on (SwitchToDesiredStateAsync(FrameSourceState.On))
OnDisappearing turns the camera off (SwitchToDesiredStateAsync(FrameSourceState.Off))
Permissions.RequestAsync<Permissions.Camera>() (or CheckStatusAsync<Permissions.Camera>()) is used
ScannedBarcode record is preserved in output
scannedBarcodes list is preserved in output
Deduplication logic (checking for existing value before adding) is preserved
MauiProgram.cs is updated to call .UseScanditCore(c => c.AddDataCaptureView()).UseScanditBarcode()
A summary of changes is shown with what was removed and what was added
Setup checklist mentions all four NuGet packages (Scandit.DataCapture.Core, Scandit.DataCapture.Core.Maui, Scandit.DataCapture.Barcode, Scandit.DataCapture.Barcode.Maui)
A concrete version number is used for the dependencies (not a [version] placeholder)
Setup checklist mentions NSCameraUsageDescription (for iOS target) or Permissions.Camera (for both targets)

evals.prompt: My .NET MAUI app decodes barcodes from photos the user picks, using ZXing.Net.Maui's BarcodeReader.DecodeAsync. I want to replace it with Scandit BarcodeCapture. Here is my page: ZxingMauiPhotoPage.xaml + ZxingMauiPhotoPage.xaml.cs
evals.expected_output: Replaces BarcodeReader.DecodeAsync with a Scandit ImageFrameSource created from the picked photo via CreateImageFrameSourceAsync, set as the DataCaptureContext frame source and switched on, with BarcodeCapture (Ean13Upca and DataMatrix enabled) reporting the result through BarcodeScanned. Keeps DecodeAsync's Task<ScannedBarcode?> contract by bridging the event with a TaskCompletionSource and a timeout for photos with no barcode. Preserves the ScannedBarcode record, the deduplicated history, the photo picker and the label text.

assertions.text: using ZXing.Net.Maui and BarcodeReader.DecodeAsync / BarcodeReaderOptions are NOT present in the migrated code (may appear in a before/after summary)
The photo path is migrated, not dropped: the output does not claim Scandit cannot decode still images or gallery photos (semantic)

An ImageFrameSource is created from the picked photo with CreateImageFrameSourceAsync on a MAUI ImageSource or Image (e.g. ImageSource.FromFile(photo.FullPath) or ImageSource.FromStream), passing an IMauiContext such as this.Handler.MauiContext
A null ImageFrameSource (image could not be loaded) is handled, e.g. treated as no barcode found
The ImageFrameSource is set as the context's frame source (SetFrameSourceAsync) and switched on with SwitchToDesiredStateAsync(FrameSourceState.On)
BarcodeCaptureSettings enables Symbology.Ean13Upca and Symbology.DataMatrix, and BarcodeCapture is created on the DataCaptureContext before the image is processed

The result is read from the BarcodeScanned event (args.Session.NewlyRecognizedBarcode Data and Symbology), not from a return value of a Scandit decode call; no invented decode method such as ScanImageAsync or Decode exists on a Scandit type (semantic)

DecodeAsync keeps returning Task<ScannedBarcode?>: the BarcodeScanned event completes a TaskCompletionSource (or equivalent), with a timeout or other end condition that yields null when the photo holds no barcode
A new ImageFrameSource is created per picked photo (no single source reused across picks without switching it off and on again)
No camera, DataCaptureView or BarcodeCaptureOverlay is added for this image-only page, or if one is added the output explains why (semantic)
DataCaptureContext.ForLicenseKey( is used to create the context
The ScannedBarcode record, the scannedBarcodes list and its deduplication check are preserved
The MediaPicker.Default.PickPhotoAsync() photo picker and the 'No barcode found in this photo' / 'Last scan' label texts are preserved
UI updates triggered from BarcodeScanned (background thread) are dispatched with MainThread.BeginInvokeOnMainThread, or the label is only set after awaiting DecodeAsync on the UI thread
MauiProgram.cs is updated with the Scandit builder calls (.UseScanditCore(...) and .UseScanditBarcode()) and ZXing's .UseBarcodeReader() is removed
Setup checklist mentions the Scandit NuGet packages including Scandit.DataCapture.Core.Maui (where CreateImageFrameSourceAsync lives) and removing the ZXing.Net.Maui package
The summary lists the move from BarcodeReader.DecodeAsync to ImageFrameSource and the no-barcode timeout as judgment calls or behaviour changes
